verdicts.reason: In A, the quote wraps well, but the attribution breaks onto two lines and the enlarged logo is crammed right next to it, so the bottom-left corner is cluttered. The glass also sits in the top half of a fully enclosed circle, which leaves the lower half empty and loses the original's corner bleed. B keeps the original's corner-bleed circle with the glass overlapping its edge and keeps the attribution on one line, but the quote ends in an orphaned 'soon.' and the logo floats at top right with little connection to anything around it.
